implementation: Cloud directly: coupled simulator observations, selection gates, immutable contracts and UI reporting. No local generation.
changes: Restored the configured positive normal-cost fold fraction (default 60%).
Every development fold must have executed trades under both normal and stressed costs before selection.
Observed equity entry sizing retains per-symbol attempts below one share, largest risk-sized quantity and risk-cap dollars, independently of optional chart capture.
Rejected scores cannot become incumbents or trigger goal completion; missing assessments fail closed for versioned studies.
Development eligibility version 1 and require_active_folds are locked into the validation contract, selected payload and validation artifact.
Saved results, terminal progress and captured trial review explain actual activity and observed sizing blockers; long rejection details wrap in keyboard-accessible tables.

checks.native_execution: Synthetic equity quantities below one whole share produce no fills and recorded blockers; fractional crypto still trades; optional capture preserves metrics and sizing observations.
checks.optimizer_lifecycle: Real Optuna/SQLite plus controlled fold results: inactive normal/stress folds, insufficient positive folds and missing activity evidence reject; parameters unchanged and holdout untouched; active qualifiers dispatch holdout; incompatible policy resume rejects.
checks.api: New rejection details survive strict API JSON serialization and research analysis. Refreshed live API reports original historical holdout consumed/rejected/nonresumable.
checks.dashboard_runtime: Restarted launcher after confirming zero active jobs; API health ok with Redis registry; frontend HTTP 200 and updated diagnostics served.

impeccable.scope: Affected rejection and trial-detail views only; incumbent Strip Recorder design preserved.
impeccable.audit: Semantic headings/lists and labeled keyboard-focusable table region retained; no new dependencies, animation, colors or layout framework. Long reason cells required wrapping.
impeccable.polish: Wrapped long rejection reasons, separated reasons into list items, distinguished missing activity evidence from recorded zero trades, clarified normal versus stressed cost requirements.
impeccable.detector: No findings on changed UI targets.
impeccable.visual_review: Chrome screenshots at 1440px and 390px inspected for saved outcomes and captured trial rejection; no document-width overflow. Table focus exercised.
impeccable.limits: Emulated viewport and keyboard checks, not physical-device or exhaustive screen-reader/contrast certification.

limits: No observed-market optimization or market holdout replay was launched for this change.
An active development candidate can still fail the one-shot holdout; these checks do not guarantee profitability or future activity.
Sizing diagnostics describe actual entry attempts. Absent observations are not interpreted as proof that risk sizing blocked orders.
Risk settings, whole-share flooring, fractional crypto sizing and consumed-study locks are preserved.
